get.summary: The account’s own reports, newest first: what each was about as the public sees it now (a placeholder by its id alone), the reason and description sent, and the result — pending, actioned (조치함) or dismissed (기각) — with when. Never the action taken nor who took it

The actions operators took on the account, newest first: the type, the reason (a report reason — or an account restriction’s own — and the operator’s explanation), what it was about (the account’s own item, nothing of it once deleted), its end when it has one — for a writing or an account restriction an operator lifted early or shortened, that kind and the end it was given — and its cancellation. An account restriction is here once another admin approved it. Never the operator, the approving admin, a report, a reporter, nor why an end changed

The restrictions that govern the account now, each as a refusal names it: the writing restriction (`restriction`, what a refused post, comment or edit names) and the account restriction (`accountRestriction`, what a refused order names) — its kind and its end (null: none, until it is lifted), the latest end of those standing, one with no end over any. Null when none of that kind stands; an account restriction not yet approved is none. Never the operator, the reason nor a report

The report queue, grouped by target: `pending` (default) — targets with a pending report, the one waiting longest first — or `resolved` — targets whose reports were all processed, the latest first. Each with the target now, its member, the counts per reason and times

post.summary: Dismiss (기각) the reports named, each pending, with a reason (recorded): nothing is done to anyone and the reporters read 기각. A report on the acting admin’s own item or profile is another admin’s (own); one processed already is `resolved`

get.summary: Every moderation action, newest first, with its reason, operator, time and cancellation — no operator on an action taken on the admin reading it (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Cancel an action with a reason (recorded): a hidden item shows again; a profile item is not restored. A nickname reset’s cancellation restores no nickname but hands the hold of the nickname taken away to the member: other accounts stay held for the rest of the 30 days from the reset, and while that hold stands the member picks that nickname, exactly as it was taken away, with no change interval, even after a pick since the reset, once (taken back and given up again, it keeps the interval, as any other nickname does). One cancelled already is `cancelled`; one on the acting admin is `own`; an account restriction is cancelled only by an approved request (`approval_required`)

Bring a standing writing restriction’s end forward (감경) to `endsAt`, with a reason (recorded, operators only): still to come (`end_passed` otherwise — a lift ends it now) and earlier than its end now (`not_earlier`; any is, for one with no end). Not a writing restriction is `not_restriction` — an account restriction `approval_required`, its end moving only by an approved request — a cancelled one `cancelled`, one ended `ended`, one on the acting admin `own`. The member reads the new end

Lift a standing writing restriction early (조기 해제), with a reason (recorded, operators only): it ends now and stays on the record as given. Refused as a shortening is (`not_restriction`, `approval_required`, `cancelled`, `ended`, `own`)

get.summary: A post whatever its state (the deleted original too), its earlier versions, the reports on it with their reporters, its actions and its author’s record of actions. On a record about the admin reading it, no reporter, report description or operator (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Hide a post with a reason: out of every list, its placeholder on its page, no new comment, no edit by its author. Resolves the pending reports on it (조치함). A deleted post is `deleted`, a hidden one `hidden`, the acting admin’s own `own`

get.summary: A 댓글 or 대댓글 whatever its state, its earlier versions, its post, the reports on it, its actions and its author’s record of actions

post.summary: Hide a 댓글 or 대댓글 with a reason, as a post. Resolves the pending reports on it (조치함)

get.summary: A member’s public profile now (its image at its operator address), the reports on it and every action on the member, with what profile actions took away

schema.description: A member’s public id (10 lower-case letters and digits, never the account id), matched ignoring case; anything else is NOT_FOUND

get.summary: The same page as `GET /admin/moderation/users/{userId}`, found by the public id of the profile’s address — the way from a public profile’s operator link

post.summary: Warn a member with a reason: a record and the member’s notice only. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`

Restrict a member’s writing (작성 제한) with a reason, for `days` (1, 3, 7 or 30) or with no end (`null`, until lifted): no new post, comment or reply, no edit of their own and no new value of a public profile item (RESTRICTED, with the end) — deleting their own, likes and reports stay open. Restricted already, the one that ends later governs. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; the acting admin is `own`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`

Give a member’s nickname back to an auto nickname with a reason; the nickname taken away is kept for operators and held from every account for 30 days (from the member too, until the reset is cancelled), and the member’s 30-day change interval is waived (they pick a new one at once). An auto nickname already is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)
Empty a member’s 소개 with a reason; it is kept for operators. None is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)
Remove a member’s profile image with a reason: served to nobody from then on and kept for operators. None is `nothing_to_remove`. Resolves the pending reports on the profile (조치함)

get.summary: The account restriction requests: `pending` (default) — those waiting for another admin’s decision, the one waiting longest first, each with what approving it would be refused for now (`moot`) — `decided` — approved or rejected, the latest decision first — or `retracted` — retracted by the admin who asked, the latest first. No asking or deciding admin and no operators’ memo on a request about the admin reading it (`aboutViewer`)

post.summary: Ask for a member’s account to be restricted (계정 제한) for `days` (1, 3, 7 or 30) or with no end (`null`), with a reason and the explanation the member will read (required). Nothing is in force until another admin approves the request: then no new order, market proposal, public profile item’s new value or account closing (RESTRICTED, with the end) — writing, likes, reports and the watchlist stay open, and the term counts from the approval. With a subject (the member’s post, comment or profile) its pending reports are resolved on approval (조치함); one not the member’s is `not_theirs`; the acting admin is `own`; an account its member closed (탈퇴) is `closed`; with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it, `no_decider`. An optional `memo` is for the operators (not the admin it is about), never the member

Ask for a standing account restriction’s end to be brought forward (감경) to `endsAt`, with a reason (operators only), done once another admin approves: still to come (`end_passed`) and earlier than its end now (`not_earlier`; any is, for one with no end). Not an account restriction is `not_account_restriction`, a cancelled one `cancelled`, one ended `ended`, one on the acting admin `own` — each asked again on approval — and with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it, `no_decider`

Ask for a standing account restriction to be lifted early (조기 해제), with a reason (operators only): once another admin approves, it ends then and stays on the record as given. Refused as a shortening is (`not_account_restriction`, `cancelled`, `ended`, `own`, `no_decider`)

Ask for an account restriction to be cancelled (취소), with a reason (operators only): once another admin approves, it ends at once and the member reads it cancelled — an ended one too. Not an account restriction is `not_account_restriction`, a cancelled one `cancelled`, one on the acting admin `own`, and with no admin but the acting one and the member to decide it `no_decider`

Approve an account restriction request, with a reason, and do what it asks in the same transaction: restrict the account from now (its term counted from now), bring its end forward, lift it or cancel it. The admin who asked cannot (`APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED` `requester`), nor the member (`own`); a decided request is `decided`, a retracted one `retracted`; what the restriction outgrew since the request is refused (`cancelled`, `ended`, `not_earlier`, `end_passed`) — reject it instead — and so is a restriction of an account its member closed (`closed`). Answers the request and the restriction as it stands

Reject an account restriction request, with a reason: nothing is done. Requests do not expire. The admin who asked cannot (`requester`) — they retract it instead — nor the member (`own`); a decided request is `decided`, a retracted one `retracted`

Retract an account restriction request the acting admin made, before anyone decides it: nothing is done, and it closes as `retracted` with when — decided by no one after. Anyone else is refused (`APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED` `not_requester`), and so is one decided (`decided`) or retracted (`retracted`) already. Answers the request

get.summary: Any stored image, whatever shows it, for operators. Revalidated on every use (ETag)

The repeated-link review list grouped by link and rule (the same person put the link in 3 or more posts and comments within 24 hours, or 3 or more people did): `open`, the entries no operator has marked, newest group first; `reviewed`, one row per mark, newest first
A review-list group's entries, newest first: those of the link and rule no operator has marked, or with `reviewId` those that mark covered — each with the item as it is now
